data.title: Robots reshape the future of homebuilding
data.description: America’s housing industry is facing a severe labor shortage and a longstanding productivity problem, creating growing interest in robotics and automation to increase homebuilding capacity, CNBC reports.  The U.S. is short roughly 1.2 million homes, while nearly 300,000 construction jobs were open at the end of 2025.
